label: Phase two — every crushed shoot is a choice
location: The Verdant Ward, the nursery rows

recentEvents.value: She told him which rows were nesting ground and which path was swept for him; he heard her and chose the rows.

notes: 'You understand every word I say, don't you? Then every crushed shoot is a choice you made.'
